AAI Junior Executive & Manager Recruitment 2026

Post Date: August 8, 2026

6:19 pm

Airports Authority of India (AAI) has released a notification for the recruitment of Junior Executive & Assistant Manager Posts on its official website. This recruitment is being conducted for 389 vacancies. The AAI Application Form has started on 08 August 2026 & the candidates can apply until 07 September 2026. The Minimum age required is N/A & The Maximum Age Is 27 – 32 Years as on 07 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for AAI Junior Executive & Manager Recruitment 2026 which are given below. (Advt No : 12/2026/CHQ/DR‐CBT)
